'''Talus''' was one of the [[Double Worlds|Twin Worlds]] located in the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] that [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] [[Centerpoint Station]], the other being [[Tralus/Legends|Tralus]], its sister [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==Description==
{{Quote|Talus and Tralus are called the Double Worlds because they are just the same size as each other. They orbit around each other. Centerpoint Station is in the balance point. the barycenter, between Talus and Tralus.|[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="AaC">''[[Ambush at Corellia]]''</ref>}}
[[File:TalusLandscape-SWGMB.jpg|thumb|left|220px|A grassy seaside landscape on Talus]]
Talus was roughly the same size as its sister planet, Tralus. Both orbited a common center of [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] and were together known as the Double Worlds. Talus was one of the five habitable planets in the [[Star system/Legends|system]], and was a temperate world very similar to [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It had a wide range of climates and terrain, including forests, grass plains and mud flats.<ref name="SWG:T" />

The planet was mostly inhabited by three sentient species: [[Human/Legends|Humans]], the [[Drall/Legends|Drall]] and the [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]]. Although the three species mostly lived peacefully, there was a history of political conflict amongst them, usually marked by sporadic violence.<ref name="SWG:T" /> Talus was also home to farmers and miners, including a noteworthy [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] colony.

==History==
Talus held many mysteries for explorers. It was rumored that a planetary [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] was located deep beneath the planetary surface. This device may have been used millennia before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] to move Talus from an unknown orbit and into its current orbit.<ref name="SWG:T" />

Originally Talus was ruled by a monarch, usually a [[Queen/Legends|Queen]]. This tradition ended, however, with the reformation period. There were nobles still on Talus as late as [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], some even claiming to be heirs to the throne.

Around [[500 BBY/Legends|500 BBY]], the [[Federation of the Double Worlds]] was founded, which became the government of Talus and Tralus. The capital of the Federation was [[Dearic/Legends|Dearic]] on Talus. [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], [[Selonia/Legends|Selonia]], and [[Drall (planet)|Drall]] allied in an attempted takeover of the Federation, which failed.

[[File:TalusCity-SWGMB.jpg|thumb|left|220px|[[Nashal]] during the Galactic Civil War]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the planet was attacked by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. [[Mallie Marek|Mallie]] and [[Kento Marek]] fought on the planet during the conflict.<ref name="TFU:GG">[[Star Wars: The Force Unleashed: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars: The Force Unleashed'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

Like Corellia, Talus remained largely neutral in the early days of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] monitored Talus for Rebel activity, but allowed Fed-Dub to operate independently and didn't interfere with the planet's major corporations. Although Talus wasn't as well known as Corellia, it had a vibrant economy that revolved around starship manufacturing.<ref name="SWG:T" />

During the [[Corellian Crisis|First Corellian Insurrection]], the [[Tralus and Talus Liberation Party]] advocated independence for both worlds. It was later [[Blockade of Corellia|blockaded]] during the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].
